ops.text: (c) HDI warrants that (1) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, and for a period of ninety (90) days following performance the Services will conform to their documentation; (2) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Site, each deliverable and any software delivered by HDI will conform to its documentation; (3) it shall perform its obligations under this Agreement in compliance with all applicable laws; and (4) the Site and any software delivered by HDI will not contain any virus, worm, disabling code or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is repair, replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only mutual corporate authority warranties, so we have added HDI's performance warranty: professional and workmanlike Services conforming to documentation for 90 days following performance, 12-month conformance for the Site, deliverables and software, compliance with laws and no malicious code, with repair, replacement or refund. This is our preferred warranty position; we can discuss the fallback 90-day software / 30-day Services periods if needed.
proposal.summary: Insert HDI performance warranty as Section 9(c): professional and workmanlike Services with 90-day conformance from performance, 12-month software/deliverable conformance to documentation, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and repair/replacement/refund remedies.
